message: Untrusted text in a structural position: an `Untrusted<String>` used where trusted `String` is required, such as a `String` parameter, field, or return type. Reported instead of `E0220` when trust is the only difference. Like `E0270`, the rule is part of type compatibility, so it holds on every route, including inside type arguments such as `Option<Untrusted<String>>`. Trusted `String` may always be used as `Untrusted<String>`. The message suggests a validator or `.assume_trusted()`. Spans the expression.
